description.en: Falling glyph streams that light up your live HTML, with drop heads that surge where your cursor cuts through.
description.zh: 下落的字符流照亮实时 HTML，光标穿过时，字符雨的前端会涌动增强。

discovery.caveat: 涉及实时 HTML 捕获；保持正文可读，浏览器要求见详情。

notice.en: Reference entry. This AI catalog does not redistribute component source. Install directly from the author's registry under its license; the @canvas-ui namespace belongs to the upstream author.
notice.zh: 来源收藏条目。本 AI 目录不重新分发组件源码；如需使用，请遵守作者许可并直接从作者的注册表安装。@canvas-ui 属于上游作者。

description.en: Characters used for the falling glyphs. Deduplicated into a glyph atlas.
description.zh: 下落字形使用的字符，去重后生成字形图集。

description.en: Size of one glyph cell in CSS pixels (8 to 64).
description.zh: 单个字形单元的尺寸，单位为 CSS 像素（8 至 64）。

description.en: Rain color as [r, g, b] in 0 to 1 range.
description.zh: 字符雨颜色，使用 [r, g, b]，范围为 0 至 1。

description.en: Color of the bright head glyph as [r, g, b] in 0 to 1 range.
description.zh: 明亮头部字形的颜色，使用 [r, g, b]，范围为 0 至 1。

description.en: Fall speed in screen heights per second (0.05 to 3).
description.zh: 下落速度，单位为屏幕高度/秒（0.05 至 3）。

description.en: Per-column speed variation (0 to 1).
description.zh: 各字符列的速度差异（0 至 1）。

description.en: Fraction of drops that spawn each cycle (0 to 1).
description.zh: 每个周期生成的雨滴比例（0 至 1）。

description.en: Length multiplier for the fading trails (0.2 to 3).
description.zh: 渐隐拖尾的长度倍数（0.2 至 3）。

description.en: Brightness of the drop heads and the light they cast (0 to 3).
description.zh: 雨滴头部及其投射光线的亮度（0 至 3）。

description.en: How fast glyphs mutate into other characters (0 to 4).
description.zh: 字形变为其他字符的速度（0 至 4）。

description.en: Random brightness flicker of the streaks (0 to 1).
description.zh: 光迹随机亮度闪烁的强度（0 至 1）。

description.en: Parallax rain layers behind the front one (1 to 3).
description.zh: 前景层后方的视差雨层数量（1 至 3）。

description.en: How much the unlit page dims (0 to 1). 0 keeps it fully readable.
description.zh: 未照亮页面的变暗程度（0 至 1），0 保持完整可读。

description.en: Strength of the light the drops shine onto the page (0 to 3).
description.zh: 雨滴照向页面的光照强度（0 至 3）。

description.en: Radius of each drop's light pool in CSS pixels (20 to 600).
description.zh: 每个雨滴光池的半径，单位为 CSS 像素（20 至 600）。

description.en: How high above the page the lights float, in CSS pixels. Higher is softer.
description.zh: 光源悬浮于页面上方的高度，单位为 CSS 像素；越高越柔和。

description.en: Embossed 3D shading of the page under the lights (0 to 2).
description.zh: 光照下页面的三维浮雕明暗强度（0 至 2）。

description.en: How strongly the cursor stirs the rain as it passes (0 to 1). 0 disables it.
description.zh: 光标经过时搅动字符雨的强度（0 至 1），0 关闭。

description.en: How far the stirring reaches to either side of the cursor, in CSS pixels.
description.zh: 搅动影响光标两侧的距离，单位为 CSS 像素。

description.en: Seconds the stirred wake takes to settle back to its own rhythm.
description.zh: 被搅动的尾流恢复自身节奏所需的秒数。

description.en: Classes applied to the wrapper element.
description.zh: 应用到包装元素的 CSS 类。

dependencies.frameworkNote: Solid uses solid-js; Preact uses preact. Other framework dependencies follow the target project.

install.behavior: Commands are metadata only. This catalog and CLI never execute installation.

browserNotes: WebGPU builds need a browser with WebGPU; verify the current browser support before choosing a renderer.
HTML-in-Canvas is experimental. Check the component's current upstream browser/fallback documentation. Do not assume DOM capture works in every browser.
